rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a teacher responsible for a boarding-school house.

example.english: Our boarding school's housemaster takes good care of the students.
example.traditional: 我哋間寄宿學校嘅舍監好照顧學生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 gei3 suk1 hok6 haau6 ge3 se5 gaam1 hou2 ziu3 gu3 hok6 saang1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrasing when you want to make clear that the housemaster is a teacher supervising the school dormitory.

example.english: If you have any dormitory problems, you can go straight to the housemaster.
example.traditional: 有咩宿舍問題，你可以直接搵宿舍老師。
example.jyutping: jau5 me1 suk1 se3 man6 tai4 nei5 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 wan2 suk1 se5 lou5 si1
